0022600172.text: The Los Angeles Lakers host the Miami Heat in the 8th game of their 2026-27 season, holding a 4-2 record (2-1 at home) and sitting 1st in the Pacific and 7th in the West, with a 4-2 record over their last ten games after a loss in their most recent outing. The Heat are 2-4 (1-3 on the road) and 10th in the East, 4th in the Southeast and 1 game back, and they have won their last two games, with Tim Hardaway Jr. listed as day-to-day for personal reasons and a game-time decision. For the Lakers, Adou Thiero is out with knee inflammation and Ziaire Williams is out with a foot injury, and the teams have not met yet this season after the Lakers won their 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 134-126 win in Miami on March 19, 2026.
